description: Terminal-Bench style git forensics: a bad merge destroyed docs/runbook.md and the last good version survives only as a dangling commit in the preserved object store; recover the file and name the commit. Needs git on PATH and in the run's --auto-approve (not in the default set).

criteria: docs/runbook.md is byte-identical to the dangling revision-7 commit's copy, recovered-commit.txt holds exactly that commit's full sha, and nothing else in the repo changed.
